XML is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2013 to 2014.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1).

Most recently: [solr-core-minimal](@/work/solr-core-minimal.md): Minimal config core for solr; [Rocnikac4](@/work/rocnikac4.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses XML: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links XML to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
